blocks.goal: Extract grouped state read behavior into a new helper class to reduce the size and complexity of the TokeniserState enum. Grouping focuses on cohesive families of states (data-like, rcdata-like, rawtext/script, tag/attribute parsing, comment/doctype).

ops.details: Create a new final class TokeniserStateReaders in package org.jsoup.parser. Provide static methods that encapsulate groups of existing read behavior currently implemented inside enum constants: readDataState(Tokeniser, CharacterReader) (for Data and CharacterReferenceInData), readRcdataState(...), readRawtextAndScriptData(...), readTagAndNameStates(...), readAttributeStates(...), readCommentStates(...), readDoctypeStates(...), readCdataSection(...). These methods will reference Tokeniser, CharacterReader, TokeniserState, TokeniserStateHelper and Token (all present in the original file). The implementation content for each method is the corresponding code moved from the enum constant read(...) bodies for the grouped states. Keep method signatures static and package-private or public as needed to be callable from TokeniserState. Do not alter behavior; only move code into the new class.

Add necessary imports (none beyond package-local types required, since Tokeniser, CharacterReader, Token, TokeniserStateHelper and DocumentType are in the same package). Ensure the new class is declared in package org.jsoup.parser so it can access package-private types if needed.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.

blocks.goal: Refactor the TokeniserState enum to delegate per-state read behavior to TokeniserStateReaders. Replace large inlined read(...) method bodies with concise delegation calls to the corresponding TokeniserStateReaders methods, reducing size and improving modularization.

ops.details: For each enum constant in TokeniserState that currently provides an overridden read(Tokeniser, CharacterReader) implementation, replace the inlined body with a single delegation call to the appropriate static method in TokeniserStateReaders. Example replacements: Data.read(...) -> TokeniserStateReaders.readDataState(t, r); Rcdata.read(...) -> TokeniserStateReaders.readRcdataState(t, r); Rawtext/ScriptData/etc -> TokeniserStateReaders.readRawtextAndScriptData(t, r, this); TagName/TagOpen/... -> TokeniserStateReaders.readTagAndNameStates(t, r, this); attribute-related states -> TokeniserStateReaders.readAttributeStates(t, r, this); comment/doctype states -> TokeniserStateReaders.readCommentStates(...) / readDoctypeStates(...). Preserve constants and arrays currently declared in TokeniserState for now (they will be handled in a subsequent step). Ensure method calls use the same parameters used by the original bodies (Tokeniser t, CharacterReader r, optionally 'this').
If necessary, add or update imports in TokeniserState.java to reference TokeniserStateReaders (same package, so typically no import is required). Keep package declaration org.jsoup.parser.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.

blocks.goal: Move long-lived constant arrays and character constants out of the enum to a small constants holder to further reduce the size of the TokeniserState enum and clarify responsibilities.

ops.details: Create a new final class TokeniserStateConstants in package org.jsoup.parser containing the character constants and arrays currently declared in TokeniserState: nullChar, attributeNameCharsSorted, attributeValueUnquoted, replacementChar reference (referencing Tokeniser.replacementChar), replacementStr, eof (CharacterReader.EOF). Make these fields public static final so TokeniserState and TokeniserStateReaders can reference them. Do not change values; just relocate them.

Replace uses of the moved constants inside TokeniserState and TokeniserStateReaders with references to TokeniserStateConstants (e.g., TokeniserStateConstants.nullChar). Update any code in TokeniserStateReaders created in block 1 to use TokeniserStateConstants. As all classes are in the same package, direct references are permitted.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.

blocks.goal: Introduce a simple façade method on TokeniserStateReaders (if helpful) to centralize calls from Tokeniser and reduce direct coupling to many static methods. This supports future incremental extraction and testing.

ops.details: Add a single static dispatch method on TokeniserStateReaders: read(TokeniserState state, Tokeniser t, CharacterReader r) that routes to the specific grouped methods based on the provided state. Update TokeniserState enum read(...) implementations to call TokeniserStateReaders.read(this, t, r) where appropriate. This reduces the number of direct call sites in TokeniserState and centralizes delegation. Keep implementation simple (switch on state groups) and package-local.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.

blocks.goal: Sanity check and minimal updates to callers if needed: ensure all call sites compile after refactoring. Update any internal call sites that referenced moved constants or inlined logic to use the new helpers.

ops.details: Build and compile the codebase, identify any usages in TokeniserState or other package classes that depended on the moved internals, and update them to reference TokeniserStateReaders or TokeniserStateConstants as appropriate. This step is to ensure the refactor is complete and the enum is slimmer. No public API change is intended.
